jp-fbneo.destination_requirements: An FBNeo build that includes the Street Fighter Alpha 3 Upper sets.
software_notes: Rebuilds both regions from the original arcade sets, both PS2 DVDs (ISO or CHD) and the NAOMI GD-ROM, then exports this layout. Later layouts reuse that reconstruction.
chdman and the pinned NumPy/SciPy wheels are prepared automatically. Allow about 16 GB of temporary space; the first reconstruction can take an hour.
